body_revisions.scope: Implement, execute and explain two stable Apple GPU softmax variants on the same continuous finite FP32 input.
body_revisions.observation: The actual M4 Pro run checked 1,118,062 values for each kernel, covered the column tail and sentinel, and observed three nonfinite values in a deliberately unshifted GPU control. The chapter table displays recorded device-time medians and ranges. CUDA and application performance remain distinct.
